name: Hikari no Umi no Apeiria ~Casablanca no Kishi~
original_name: 景の海のアペイリア ～カサブランカの騎士～
source:
This is the fandisc for Hikari no Umi no Apeiria. Reiichi’s friend disappeared. After consulting with Sara and Nanami, he found out about the existence of an app called the Boundary II α system. He logged in once more to Second to solve the mystery of his friend’s log-in for over a month. This was the beginning of a new incident. He must find a way to log-out of the α system in which he was trapped, but he had forgotten everything about Apeiria…

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/10/17/october-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是《Hikari no Umi no Apeiria》的同人光盘。礼一的朋友失踪了。在咨询了莎拉和七海之后，他发现了一个名为“边界II α”系统的应用程序的存在。他再次登录Second，解开朋友一个多月来的登录之谜。这是新事件的开始。他必须想办法退出自己被困的α系统，但他已经忘记了关于阿佩里亚的一切……

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/10/17/october-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
